description: Net Operating Hours: same filters as dvw-jfb-goh-v2, but only sums jfb_daily_activities whose category is one of ACTIVE DREDGING / DREDGING / PRODUCTION / ACTIVE CAPPING / CAPPING / ACTIVE PLACEMENT / PLACEMENT. Companion to dvw-jfb-goh-v2. That allow-list is the non-native app's isOperationalCategory() in src/lib/eventTotals.ts and this app's own src/lib/operationalCategory.js, kept verbatim -- change one and you must change the other. It replaced a delay_code_id IS NULL test on 2026-09-23: 'no delay code' is NOT the productive signal. Weigand 422509 has 85 uncoded STARTUP/SHUTDOWN activities in Supabase itself, and 14 Startup activities whose code 9000 never migrated, so the old rule read 103.47 NOH against the reference app's 98.59. TRANSITION falls out of the allow-list on its own. Area, pass, TSCA and attachment are the activity's EFFECTIVE values (tr/ea laterals): an activity with no area of its own takes all four from the latest TRANSITION marker on the same equipment and report_date at or before its start, and one with its own area keeps it but takes the marker's attachment when it has none -- the non-native app's buildCombosFromEvents rule, mirrored client-side in src/lib/transitionState.js. Change one and you must change the other.
direct_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (da.end_date_time - da.start_date_time)) / 3600.0), 0) AS noh_hours FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities da LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.area, t.pass_type, t.tsca, t.attachment_id FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities t WHERE (NOT (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') OR da.attachment_id IS NULL) AND upper(btrim(t.category)) = 'TRANSITION' AND t.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND t.project_id = da.project_id AND t.equipment_id = da.equipment_id AND t.report_date = da.report_date AND t.start_date_time <= da.start_date_time ORDER BY t.start_date_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1) tr ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.area ELSE tr.area END AS area, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.pass_type ELSE tr.pass_type END AS pass_type, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.tsca ELSE tr.tsca END AS tsca, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN COALESCE(da.attachment_id, tr.attachment_id) ELSE tr.attachment_id END AS attachment_id) ea WHERE da.project_id = p_project_id AND da.start_date_time::date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND (p_equipment_id IS NULL OR da.equipment_id = p_equipment_id) AND (ea.area->>'area_id')::uuid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_area_id AND ea.pass_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_pass_type AND ea.tsca IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_tsca AND ea.attachment_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_attachment_id AND upper(btrim(da.category)) IN ('ACTIVE DREDGING', 'DREDGING', 'PRODUCTION', 'ACTIVE CAPPING', 'CAPPING', 'ACTIVE PLACEMENT', 'PLACEMENT') AND da.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE

parameters.name: p_project_id
parameters.description: Project to scope the sum to.

parameters.name: p_start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the activity date range (compared against start_date_time::date).

parameters.name: p_end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the activity date range.

parameters.name: p_equipment_id
parameters.description: Equipment scope filter. Null includes all equipment (a broader-scope choice, not a combo dimension).

parameters.name: p_area_id
parameters.description: Combo identity dimension, matched exactly (IS NOT DISTINCT FROM against jfb_daily_activities.area->>'area_id') -- pass the row's own area_id, or null to match only activities with no area set (the 'Unassigned' bucket). Null here does NOT mean 'all areas'.

parameters.name: p_pass_type
parameters.description: Combo identity dimension, matched exactly including null -- pass the row's own pass_type, or null to match only activities with no pass_type set.

parameters.name: p_tsca
parameters.description: Combo identity dimension, matched exactly including null -- pass the row's own tsca, or null to match only activities with tsca unset.

parameters.name: p_attachment_id
parameters.description: Combo identity dimension, matched exactly including null -- pass the row's own attachment_id, or null to match only activities with no attachment set.

columns.name: noh_hours
columns.description: Net Operating Hours -- summed duration of only matching activities with no delay_code_id; 0 when none match.
